messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: [INCIDENT] decode-pool-us-west2: sudden GPU OOM spike causing streaming request drops. Paging oncall @Eve.
Eve: I'm on it — where's the initial signal?
ops-bot: Telemetry: 10x OOM rate in last 2m on pool `decode-gpu-12`, spike in token lengths. Sample trace: `CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY`.
Mike: seeing similar from logs, a set of requests with `max_tokens=100000`. probable runaway generation / misconfig.
Lisa: any customer-facing impact yet?
Aisha: Support: several customers reporting truncated responses / 5xxs since 12:07. Ticket #INC-3421 opened.
Eve: ok first action: throttle streaming routes and enforce `max_tokens` cap at 4096 for now. Mike can you push a policy to the router?
Mike: working on a hotpatch. pushing to canary now: `router.policy.max_tokens = 4096` and `streaming.enabled = false` for affected model variants.
eng-runtime-bot: deploy started -> canary on decode-gpu-12 (3 nodes). ETA ~60s.
Eve: also enable request drop logs for affected client ids: add header `x-rw-incident=5460001112` so we can trace.
Lisa: isolating the bad node set and draining. `kubectl cordon gpu-node-42` then `kubectl drain gpu-node-42 --ignore-daemonsets`.
Mike: log snippet:
```
[2026-03-15T12:09:03Z] ERROR decode_worker: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY at decode_loop.cpp:218
[2026-03-15T12:09:03Z] WARN request: client=acme-inc req_id=abc123 tokens_generated=120000
```
Ben: customer-ops: acme-inc impacted heavily. their SLA alerts triggered. prepping a one-line customer update.
Aisha: pls cc me on the update. we'll send preliminary note: "We're investigating increased errors for streaming responses..."
Eve: confirm canary health -> Mike?
Mike: canary looks stable, OOM rate down 95% on canary nodes. Rolling to remaining nodes now.
eng-runtime-bot: rollout 30% -> 60% -> 100% progressing. next step in ~3m.
Lisa: gpu-node-42 has repeated cuda OOMs and container restarts, planning a full reboot. scheduling now.
Eve: trigger temporary fallback routing to `small-quant` variant for at-risk customers while node reboot happens.
Mike: fallback rule added. also enabling aggressive kv-prefix caching to reduce decode length.
Ben: ETA for customer note? 15 min? we need a short impact summary and mitigation steps.
Aisha: sending update: "Issue: GPU OOMs causing streaming failures. Mitigation: throttled streaming, enforced max_tokens cap, routing fallbacks, node reboot. Engineers remain on it."
Eve: good. next - postmortem items: why max_tokens misconfig allowed 100k through? add validation in config schema.
Mike: adding a validation rule and unit tests. also adding telemetry alert: token-length 99th percentile > 8192 triggers page.
Eve: after node reboot we'll keep enhanced throttles for 1h and monitor.
eng-runtime-bot: node rebooted gpu-node-42 -> status ready. OOMs stopped on that host.
Mike: rollout complete, OOMs at baseline. removing streaming disable for non-impacted customers in 10m.
Aisha: closing immediate customer-facing update. will follow up after postmortem.
Eve: handing off to oncall rotation @Lisa for continued monitoring. I'm off primary oncall after this.
Lisa: acknowledged, will keep an eye for 30m and then hand to SRE.
incident-bot: incident severity downgraded -> SEV3. recording timeline and attaching logs.
